step1_analysis.description: A front-end receiver circuit combining a cascode low-noise amplifier (LNA) and an active mixer. The LNA (XM1, XM4) provides initial RF amplification, and the active mixer (XM5, XM2, XM3) downconverts the RF signal to a baseband/IF frequency using a differential local oscillator (LO).

paper_reference.title: A Merged CMOS LNA and Mixer for a WCDMA Receiver

lna_gain.description: Voltage gain of the LNA stage at the 2.1 GHz operating frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: With W=5u, L=0.5u, and Vgs=0.7V, gm is approx 750uS. Using a 2k ohm load, Gain = gm * Rload = 1.5 (3.5 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the chosen load resistor and bias current. 3.5 dB is expected for a 2k load with the provided small device sizes.

conversion_gain.description: Total voltage conversion gain from RF input to differential IF output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mixer CG = (2/pi) * gm * Rload ~ 0.95. Total Gain = LNA_Gain * Mixer_CG = 1.5 * 0.95 = 1.42 (3 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 23 dB likely due to larger device sizes, higher load impedances, or additional baseband amplification. With W=5u, 3 dB is expected.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the LNA and Mixer.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ~ 105uA per branch (LNA and Mixer). Total Id ~ 210uA. Power = 1.8V * 210uA = 0.38 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Significantly lower than the paper because the provided netlist uses small W=5u devices compared to a full WCDMA front-end.

noise_figure.description: Noise figure of the merged LNA and mixer from 5 kHz to 5 MHz IF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dependent on gm and channel noise factor gamma.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Modern 130nm nodes have good noise performance, but the small W=5u limits the minimum achievable NF without matching.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by transistor linearity and overdrive voltage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical for a CMOS active mixer and cascode LNA without specific linearization techniques.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure LNA gain at 2.1 GHz, Mixer conversion gain at 1 MHz IF, and total DC power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Merged LNA and Mixer Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N5 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 IF_OUT LO N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IF_OUT_BAR LO_BAR N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 VBIAS N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* LNA Bias and Load
V_LNA_SRC N3 0 0
V_VBIAS VBIAS 0 1.2
R_LNA_LOAD VDD N1 2k
V_LNA_IN N4 0 DC 0.7 AC 1 SIN(0.7 10m 2.1G)

* Mixer Bias and AC Coupling from LNA
C_AC N1 N2 10p
V_MIX_BIAS N2_bias 0 0.7
R_MIX_BIAS N2_bias N2 10k

* LO Signals (2.101 GHz for 1 MHz IF)
V_LO LO 0 DC 1.2 SIN(1.2 0.6 2.101G)
V_LO_BAR LO_BAR 0 DC 1.2 SIN(1.2 0.6 2.101G 0 0 180)

* Mixer Loads
R_MIX_LOAD1 VDD IF_OUT 2k
R_MIX_LOAD2 VDD IF_OUT_BAR 2k
C_MIX_LOAD1 IF_OUT 0 5p
C_MIX_LOAD2 IF_OUT_BAR 0 5p

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * 1. DC Power Consumption
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. LNA Voltage Gain
  ac dec 10 1G 10G
  let lna_gain_db = vdb(N1)
  meas ac lna_gain_2_1G find lna_gain_db at=2.1G

  * 3. Mixer Conversion Gain
  tran 10p 2u
  * Measure peak-to-peak of single-ended IF output over the second 1MHz cycle
  meas tran if_max max v(IF_OUT) from=1u to=2u
  meas tran if_min min v(IF_OUT) from=1u to=2u
  let if_pp = if_max - if_min
  * Differential conversion gain = (Differential Output Amp) / (Input Amp)
  * Diff Output Amp = if_pp. Input Amp = 10mV.
  let conv_gain = if_pp / 10m
  let conv_gain_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain)
  print conv_gain_db
  
  quit
.endc
